caption: The drawing features a single object centrally placed against a plain, off-white background. The object is a flask-shaped container, brown in color, with a slightly glossy appearance, indicative of metal or possibly leather. The flask tapers towards the top, where a metallic spout with threading and a small side lever is located. The main body of the flask is decorated with embossed or engraved designs, including a detailed depiction of a stag being chased by a dog amidst foliage. The bottom and sides of the flask feature metal loops, likely for attaching a carrying strap. Below the flask, there is small printed text that reads "STANLEY MAZUR." The overall composition is clean with ample negative space around the detailed illustration of the flask.
title: Powder Flask
